title: THE NIGHT LAMP // THE FROZEN LAKE
narrative: The blizzard screams across the crofter's village. Upon the tiny islet between the two frozen lakes, Stannis orders the false beacon lit high in the watchtower. Below, disguised beneath a dusting of fresh powder, the fishermen's holes perforate the ice like swiss cheese. When Hosteen Frey's heavy barded warhorses charge the glowing beacon with banners raised, the lake gives a sickening groan. Three thousand knights and spearmen crash through the shattered crust into the black sub-zero depths, swallowed by the freezing water while Stannis watches without blinking, his teeth grinding like millstones.
resolvesPlotHole: The Battle of Ice / Night Lamp Theory

options.text: March the victorious army toward the snow-choked walls of Winterfell.
Send riders to rendezvous with Wyman Manderly's advancing vanguard.
Summon the Braavosi banker Tycho Nestoris to seal the war loan.
Stannis's teeth grinding: Stannis clenches his jaw so hard the acoustic resonance shears the Wall.
